title: Yanlış anlaşılanlar defteri, depo: tablo + migration, dört nedenle yazan tek işlev, 30 günlük süpürme, 'unut', sahibin API'si
roadmap_row: Always-listening natural conversation, interruptible, in the owner's language (order 6, Voice and character; ADR-0224's target of 95% on the sentences the STT wrote)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-yanlis-anlasilan-cumle-defteri.md, the storage half: a NEW package services/api/app/voice/misheard (this card owns its __init__.py) that keeps the sentence the recogniser WROTE when the system did not understand it. Nothing is wired into the voice relay by this card (that is misheard-relay-wiring) and no intent, tool or page is added. CONTRACT (identical in the four misheard-* cards): table `misheard_utterances` - id (uuid, pk), heard_at (timestamptz, UTC), sentence (the recogniser's written words, 1..2000 characters, never audio), mode ('paid' | 'local'), engine (the recogniser's name when the client sent one, else null; at most 64), device_id (the session's device, else null), band ('high' | 'medium' | 'low' | null), confidence (number | null), reason (exactly one of 'no_intent', 'asked_question', 'objected', 'tool_failed'), resolved_intent (what the router made of it, at most 64, null for none), tool (the failed tool's name for 'tool_failed', else null), session_id, meant (the owner's answer, at most 2000, null until answered), answered_at (null until answered), expires_at (= heard_at + 30 days). API under the owner session: GET /v1/voice/misheard -> {items: [...], open: <count of unanswered>, retention_days: 30}, newest first, each item carrying exactly the columns above; POST /v1/voice/misheard/{id}/meaning with {meant: <1..2000 characters>} -> the item; DELETE /v1/voice/misheard/{id} -> one row gone; DELETE /v1/voice/misheard -> {deleted: <n>}, every row gone ('defteri unut'). A refusal is {detail: {code, message}} with a Turkish message. BUILD: (1) models.py + the migration (additive only: one CREATE TABLE and its indexes, a downgrade that drops it; down_revision = the head of the base branch, 0063_team_state today - if another 0064 has landed, stop after the red test and return an ALAN_ISTEGI line with the new file name, do not rename silently); register the model in alembic/env.py beside the other imports. (2) service.py, pure of FastAPI: `record(...)` is the ONE writer - it writes nothing and returns None for listen_only=True, an empty sentence, an unknown reason or mode; cuts sentence / engine / resolved_intent to their widths; is idempotent on (session_id, heard_at): a second call returns the first row and the first reason stays; a database fault never reaches the caller and never poisons the caller's transaction (savepoint), and what it logs never contains the sentence. `is_request(candidates, machine_named)` - the lead's narrowing of the proposal's first condition, most restrictive safe option (TEAM_PROTOCOL 3a item 3, write 'sahip incelemesi bekliyor' in the ADR): a sentence with no intent is a notebook row only when the understanding policy saw at least one candidate reading or the sentence named a machine; plain conversation is never stored. `hold(session_id, entry, now)` / `held(session_id, now)` - an IN-PROCESS holder of the latest sentence per session (with its mode, engine, device, band, confidence, resolved intent, heard_at), 120 s time-to-live as a named constant, never written to disk, the database, the session's context_json or a log; `reset_hold()` for tests. It exists because an objection and a failed tool arrive AFTER the sentence, and the audit row and the route telemetry are wordless on purpose. `purge(db, now)` deletes rows whose expires_at has passed; `forget_all`, `forget_one`, `answer`, `list_items` (never returns an expired row even when no purge has run). (3) routes.py: the four calls of the CONTRACT on its own APIRouter under require_owner_session (the shape of app/team/allowlist_routes.py); GET purges before it lists; registered in app/main.py next to the team routers. (4) app/main.py lifespan: purge at start and once every 24 h, in the shape the existing lifespan loops have, cancelled cleanly at shutdown; record() also purges. The ADR (team/plans/misheard-ledger-store-adr.md, the lead numbers it) states: the columns and four reasons, why the hold is in process, the is_request narrowing and that the owner may widen it, the three purge triggers and why none of them is a session (TEAM_PROTOCOL 9), KVKK (text only, 30 days, own PostgreSQL, no voice identity: another person's sentence can land here - ADR-0171), that the audit row stays wordless, and that the release carries a migration.
acceptance: Red first (the report shows the red run before the package existed). services/api/tests/unit/test_misheard_store.py proves, one named test each: every one of the four reasons writes a row with every CONTRACT column; listen_only=True writes nothing for each reason; an unknown reason, an unknown mode and an empty sentence write nothing; a 2500-character sentence is stored as 2000; the same (session_id, heard_at) twice is ONE row with the first reason; is_request is false for (no candidates, no machine) and true for each of the other three combinations; hold/held returns the entry inside 120 s, nothing after it, nothing for another session, and a second hold replaces the first; a row is listed on day 30 and purged on day 31 (clock passed in, no sleep); list_items never returns an expired row even when purge did not run; answer sets meant and answered_at and keeps the sentence; forget_all returns the count and leaves zero rows; run purge twice - the second changes nothing; no log record of any of these paths contains the sentence. test_misheard_routes.py, through the REAL application object: the four calls of the CONTRACT with their exact paths and shapes; 401 without the owner session on each; POST with an empty or 2001-character meant is 422 with a Turkish message; an unknown id is 404; GET's `open` counts unanswered rows only. tests/integration/test_misheard_postgres.py on the dev stack's PostgreSQL after the real migrations (alembic upgrade head): the table exists with the CONTRACT columns and widths; record -> list -> answer -> forget_all round trip; a write that fails (forced) leaves the caller's transaction usable - the statement after it succeeds - which SQLite would hide; downgrade drops the table and upgrade recreates it. test_postgres_coverage_ratchet.py passes WITHOUT editing its frozen list; test_host_snapshot_schema.py and test_migration_model_agreement.py pass. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy, three separate mutations, each turning a named test red: the listen_only guard removed; the expiry filter of list_items removed; the idempotence check removed. Full unit suite and the integration suite green with raw counts. No file outside the area is changed.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the red-first run, the unit counts, the integration run on the dev stack's PostgreSQL (not NOT_RUN - TEAM_PROTOCOL 9a), the three mutation REDs with restore hashes, 40-hex sha. Nothing here is READY_FOR_OWNER: no sentence reaches the table until misheard-relay-wiring. The report names the release exception: this card carries a migration, so its release is asked of the owner (ADR-0214 addendum 9).

title: Yanlış anlaşılanlar defteri, bağlantı: ücretli ve yerel oturumda dört koşul deftere yazar; anlaşılan cümle, 'sadece dinle' ve denetim satırı sözsüz kalır
roadmap_row: Always-listening natural conversation, interruptible, in the owner's language (order 6, Voice and character; ADR-0224's target of 95% on the sentences the STT wrote)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-yanlis-anlasilan-cumle-defteri.md, the four conditions, wired into the ONE relay every utterance and every tool call passes through (services/api/app/voice/realtime_sessions/service.py: record_client_events and handle_tool_call). The store is on main when this card starts (app.voice.misheard.service: record, is_request, hold, held). CONTRACT (identical in the four misheard-* cards): table `misheard_utterances` - id (uuid, pk), heard_at (timestamptz, UTC), sentence (the recogniser's written words, 1..2000 characters, never audio), mode ('paid' | 'local'), engine (the recogniser's name when the client sent one, else null; at most 64), device_id (the session's device, else null), band ('high' | 'medium' | 'low' | null), confidence (number | null), reason (exactly one of 'no_intent', 'asked_question', 'objected', 'tool_failed'), resolved_intent (what the router made of it, at most 64, null for none), tool (the failed tool's name for 'tool_failed', else null), session_id, meant (the owner's answer, at most 2000, null until answered), answered_at (null until answered), expires_at (= heard_at + 30 days). API under the owner session: GET /v1/voice/misheard -> {items: [...], open: <count of unanswered>, retention_days: 30}, newest first, each item carrying exactly the columns above; POST /v1/voice/misheard/{id}/meaning with {meant: <1..2000 characters>} -> the item; DELETE /v1/voice/misheard/{id} -> one row gone; DELETE /v1/voice/misheard -> {deleted: <n>}, every row gone ('defteri unut'). A refusal is {detail: {code, message}} with a Turkish message. WIRING, in record_client_events for an `utterance` event with non-empty text, AFTER the understanding decision is made: (a) 'objected' - route_telemetry.observe already returns the MisrouteCandidate when THIS turn completed one (ADR-0133); when it does, read the sentence HELD for this session (the acted sentence, with ITS mode / band / resolved intent / heard_at) and record it; the held entry is read BEFORE this turn's sentence replaces it - the row carries 'Ofisü bilgisayarında hesap makinesini açın', never 'hayır'. (b) 'asked_question' - the decision carries a question (ADR-0224 layer 3, LOW). (c) 'no_intent' - the intent is NONE after routing and after the pending-answer step, and misheard.is_request(decision's candidates, machine named) is true. One sentence is one row: (b) is tried before (c); the store's idempotence holds the rest. (d) then hold this turn's sentence in process (every mode). In handle_tool_call: 'tool_failed' - the handler itself failed (VoiceError, a crash, or a terminal status of failed from terminal_status_for) while a sentence is held for this session; the tool's name goes in `tool`. NOT a notebook row: a replayed call, the step-up refusal, the research follow-up refusal, an unknown tool, the layer-3 refusal (that turn is already 'asked_question'). mode = 'local' when the session's provider is LOCAL_ROUTER_PROVIDER_NAME, else 'paid'; engine = the event payload's recogniser name when the client sends one (the chrome-on-device-stt card adds it), else null, never guessed; device_id = the session's declared or bound device. LISTEN-ONLY: no listen-only mode exists in services/api/app today (ADR-0171 step 3 is not built - grep again when you start); the wiring asks ONE private helper in service.py whether the session is listen-only, the helper returns False today and names ADR-0171 as its future source, and when it is true nothing is recorded AND nothing is held. UNCHANGED, each held by a test: the voice_intent_resolved audit metadata, the ledger's misroute note and context_json carry no sentence the notebook added (the existing chat_question rule for a local session is byte-for-byte as it is); the route, the band, the tool result and the response of the turn are what they were - a failure of the notebook never changes or fails a turn. If the store needs a change, services/api/app/voice/misheard/service.py is in this card's area; services/api/app/voice/intents.py and realtime_sessions/tools.py are other cards' and are not touched. ADR in team/plans/misheard-relay-wiring-adr.md (the lead numbers it): the four trigger points with their line anchors, what is deliberately not a row, the read-before-replace order, the listen-only helper.
acceptance: Red first. services/api/tests/unit/test_misheard_relay.py drives the REAL record_client_events and handle_tool_call with the real tool registry (the way tests/unit/test_understanding_relay.py builds its session - never a hand-built turn record), each case in BOTH a paid session and a local-router session: (1) a sentence that names a machine no alias binds and routes nowhere -> one 'no_intent' row with the sentence, the mode, band and confidence; (2) plain conversation with no candidate ('Bugün nasılsın') -> no row; (3) the real rendering 'Ofisü bilgisayarında hesap makinesini açın.' when the policy asks its one question -> one 'asked_question' row, not also a 'no_intent' one; (4) an understood sentence ('Hesap makinesini aç') whose tool succeeds -> no row; (5) an acting sentence followed inside 12 s by 'hayır' -> one 'objected' row whose sentence is the ACTED sentence and whose resolved_intent is the acted intent; the same 'hayır' 13 s later -> no row; (6) a tool whose handler raises VoiceError, one that crashes, and one whose result earns failed -> one 'tool_failed' row each with the tool's name; a step-up refusal, an unknown tool, a replay of the same call_id and the layer-3 refusal -> no 'tool_failed' row; two failed tools in one turn -> one row; (7) with the listen-only helper patched to true: no row and nothing held, for all four conditions; (8) after every case above the session's context_json, every audit_events row and every ledger row are searched for the sentence text and do not contain it (except the existing local-mode chat_question, asserted equal to what it was before this card); (9) with misheard.record patched to raise, the utterance and the tool call return exactly what they return without the notebook. tests/integration/test_misheard_relay_postgres.py on the dev stack's PostgreSQL: cases 1, 3, 5 and 6 through the real relay, the rows read back through a FRESH session; and a forced notebook failure leaves the turn's own transaction committed. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy, three separate mutations: hold moved before the read of the held entry (case 5 then stores 'hayır'); the listen-only check removed; the step-up exclusion removed. tests/unit/test_understanding_relay.py, the voice corpus and the STT corpus suites pass unchanged with raw counts; full unit suite green. No file outside the area is changed.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: red-first run, unit counts per mode, the PostgreSQL integration run (not NOT_RUN), three mutation REDs with restore hashes, 40-hex sha. READY_FOR_OWNER (after the release, which carries the store's migration and is asked of the owner): on MAIL in the paid mode say five sentences, one deliberately odd; open /core/misheard and see that one sentence with its mode and machine. PROVEN_REAL is written only from the owner's own report. The report states plainly that 'sadece dinle' is proven at the helper and the store, not against a real listen-only mode, because that mode does not exist yet.
